notes: Statuses are scope-specific: a passed local CI does not mean merchant/hosted acceptance; in_review is not verified.
The legacy eight-phase manifest stays archival only; phases never determine work order.
Ready tasks are computed from direct dependencies, never manually forced by phase.
GitHub issue and PR links are evidence pointers only; do not infer live deployment or merge.
Production/Shopify submission requires real exact-source security, Shopify, billing and E2E gates.
